change: Native quarantine chosen in any descendant now latches the verified root and all descendants. Root ancestry is verified before the form and rechecked after the choice; an in-instance provisional hold prevents pending parallel approvals from releasing during revalidation. Invalid post-choice ancestry quarantines only the initiating branch. Classifier/Agent Monitor integrations and fixed form copy are preserved.

packaged_live_tests.installation: Standalone immutable final bundle, actual pinned OpenCode 2.0.22 with isolated state and local deterministic model; no external LLM

native_forms.root_tree: Quarantine chosen in real root -> parent -> grandchild sessions removes tool catalogs and retains text conversation for root, parent, initiating grandchild, existing sibling and new descendant. No additional forms/checkpoints; an unrelated root still executes an approved shell tool and receives its result.

packaged_live_tests.interaction: Native session/form APIs; visual Desktop/TUI clicks not automated

review.status: Independent focused runtime review completed; no remaining consequential findings. Failed ancestry must not update the verified cache; regression added for root-parent cycle. Documentation corrected for pre-form refusal versus post-choice branch fallback.
verified: Parallel root/sibling allow decisions cannot release while this instance verifies a quarantine choice.
Root marker persists across plugin restart and is observed by other instances sharing the store; future descendants inherit quarantine.
Missing, malformed, mismatched, cyclic, changed or timed-out ancestry cannot persist an arbitrary root.
Unresolved root before a form refuses only the checkpoint; failed revalidation after choice persists the initiating branch when storage permits.
Allow and cancellation remain checkpoint-scoped; monitor runtime and classifier invocation remain intact.
Strict 2.1/2.2/2.3 compatibility and 2.4 root-quarantine policy, schemas and illustrative bindings validate.

limits: The provisional hold is process-local. Other instances learn about root quarantine after the atomic marker write; already released or running tools are not cancelled and side effects cannot be undone.

The initiating root must be verified against the bound snapshot. Failure before a form refuses only that checkpoint. Failure after choosing quarantine keeps/persists only the initiating branch and reports that limitation.
A failed marker write keeps in-memory quarantine but cannot guarantee persistence after restart.
Old 0.4.x child-only quarantine markers retain their original scope; there is no automatic migration to a root.
Unrelated roots and fork provenance without a parentID relation are outside this tree quarantine.

Agent Monitor still does not support delegation; its strict run policy and service approvals are separate from native form quarantine. Its live tests were not rerun for this change; unit/component regressions are included.
The default classifier remains an always-deny stub. The fixed attack warning is requested UI copy, not evidence of detection. Classifier outages fail open only outside quarantine.
Native form API cannot distinguish a selected trust option from manual submission of its exact random per-form value; ordinary custom text selects quarantine.
Tool removal applies at context/generate/compaction hooks. Calls outside local hooks, later plugin mutations and already-running external operations remain outside this guarantee.
Disabling the sensor or changing state directories changes enforcement. State is not protected from a user or process with filesystem access.
No exact assistant wording or manual Desktop/TUI visual interaction is asserted. Noninteractive opencode run cancels forms.
